plugin_info.details: This plugin allows users to import molecular structure files from their local computers.
plugin_info.title: Open Molecule Files

user_args.description: If appropriate for the file format, removes any counterions and keeps only the largest fragment.
user_args.label: Desalt molecules

user_args.description: If checked, molecules will be initially invisible. You will have to toggle visibility by hand. Useful if you plan to load many molecules at once.
user_args.label: Loaded molecules should be invisible

user_args.description: If your file lacks 3D coordinates (e.g., SMILES), choose how to generate those coordinates. Otherwise, this parameter is ignored. Try different methods only if your imported molecules have incorrect geometries.
user_args.label: Method for generating 3D coordinates

options.description: fastest: no forcefield optimization or conformer search
fast: quick forcefield optimization, no conformer search
medium: quick forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
better: medium forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
best: max forcefield optimization and thorough conformer search
